summary: Report dependency admission through the trusted native Actions job
details: Name the trusted reporter job Dependency Policy and use a read-only job-result mode instead of creating a synthetic required check.

Require a successful evaluation, a current UTC assessment day and authenticated matching PR/base/head coordinates for a successful job exit; run the reporter on cancellation instead of conditionally skipping a required job.
Retain the previous publication command for compatibility while removing check-write permission from the current workflow.

compatibility.notes: CI reporting only; dependency decisions, required context/app binding and strict branch protection are unchanged. The native job requires adoption by the trusted base workflow.

security: Failed, skipped, cancelled, stale or unavailable evaluations cannot produce a successful native job; proposed code and artifacts do not run in the trusted reporter.
limitations: Local tests do not establish GitHub protection recognition; hosted qualification follows trusted-base adoption.
No branch protection change, manual success publication or check bypass is included.
